nova_burst.name: Nova Burst
nova_burst.desc: Ring blast around you: radius {radius} m, x{damage} gun damage, knocks enemies back.

chain_lightning.name: Chain Lightning
chain_lightning.desc: Lightning hits your target and jumps to {jumps} more enemies, x{damage} gun damage, shocked enemies take +{vuln}% damage for 4 s.

gravity_well.name: Gravity Well
gravity_well.desc: Throw an orb: pulls enemies within {radius} m for {seconds} s, then detonates for x{damage} gun damage.

frost_pulse.name: Frost Pulse
frost_pulse.desc: Freezes enemies within {radius} m for {seconds} s (bosses are only slowed). Frozen enemies take +{vuln}% damage.

swarm_drones.name: Swarm Drones
swarm_drones.desc: {drones} drones shoot the nearest enemies for {seconds} s, each shot {damage} of your gun damage.

rally_cry.name: Rally Cry
rally_cry.desc: For {seconds} s you deal +{damage}% damage and heal {regen}% max health per second.
